incidents.name: AventaRewardClaim balance-based claim replayed from fresh addresses
incidents.notes: AventaRewardClaim sized a claim from the caller's current IntelliQuant balance and only required user == msg.sender, so a chain of fresh helper addresses could each buy IntelliQuant, claim AVENTA out of the owner's allowance, and sell both tokens back within a single flash-swap.

sources.ref: onchain review: AventaRewardClaim 0x33b860fc7787e9e4813181b227eaffa0cada4c73 created 2024-08-29T13:20:59Z by 0x084163a613970cf80c519408dee254bba2bbd667, not the attack-tx sender 0x7c982e93d6b1ede9626a84ebeafbc42e5991dee8; no EIP-1967 events, 240.8 days old. AVENTA is the project's own illiquid token, so no USD figure is asserted; the transaction's WETH transfer log shows roughly 3.9 WETH of sale proceeds routed to the helper addresses (about $7k at $1,804.24, DefiLlama, at the incident timestamp), which is an order-of-magnitude check that the $1,000 floor is cleared.
